# 作为过程的标准因果模型 / Standard causal models as processes

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> x′ = F(x, u, ε) is a determined process whose move is the input and the noise. An intervention is a move not taken, unfixed by the record and fixed by the model; noise is a move not represented, and with it forgotten the process stays determined exactly where the noise makes no difference.
>
> x′ = F(x, u, ε) 是动作为输入与噪声的确定过程。干预是未取的动作，记录不固定它，模型固定它；噪声是未表示的动作，忘掉它时过程恰在噪声不造成差别之处仍确定。

## 主张 Claim

对任意 F : X → U → E → X，标准模型 inputs F 是配置 X 上、动作为（输入，噪声）的过程：x 以 (u, e) 到达 F x u e；它是确定的（inputs_determined）。trajectory F x₀ u e 是从 x₀ 在输入 u 与噪声 e 之下的轨迹，inputsRun 是它作为运行，动作为 (u n, e n)。对 inputs F 的任一运行，运行在 t 之前没有于 x 取 (u′, e′)、X 有两个不同的元素时，直到 t 的记录不固定 (u′, e′) 在 x 的任何结果（inputs_intervention_unfixed，Run.not_fixes_of_untaken 的实例）；模型把它送到 F x u′ e′，且只送到那里（inputs_model_fixes）。对动作为对的任一过程，forget 忘掉动作的第二部分：u 从 s 到 s′，当某个 e 使 (u, e) 从 s 到 s′；Run.forget 是相应的运行。忘掉噪声后，标准模型确定，恰当对每个 x、u 与 e、e′，F x u e = F x u e′（forget_inputs_determined_iff）。所贴的适应动力学 x′ = F_θ(x)、θ′ = G(θ, x) 是 projection-carrying-a-law 中的 adaptive，联合配置上的确定过程。不用 Lean 公理。 / For any F : X → U → E → X, the standard model inputs F is the process on configurations X with moves (input, noise): x goes by (u, e) to F x u e; it is determined (inputs_determined). trajectory F x₀ u e is the trajectory from x₀ under inputs u and noise e, and inputsRun is it as a run with moves (u n, e n). For any run of inputs F, where the run has not taken (u′, e′) at x before t and X has two different elements, the record up to t fixes no outcome of (u′, e′) at x (inputs_intervention_unfixed, an instance of Run.not_fixes_of_untaken); the model sends it to F x u′ e′ and nowhere else (inputs_model_fixes). For any process whose moves are pairs, forget forgets the second part of the move: u goes from s to s′ where (u, e) does for some e; Run.forget is the corresponding run. With the noise forgotten the standard model is determined exactly where F x u e = F x u e′ for every x, u and e, e′ (forget_inputs_determined_iff). The pasted adaptive dynamics x′ = F_θ(x), θ′ = G(θ, x) is adaptive in projection-carrying-a-law, a determined process on the joint configuration. No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不加前提：F 是任意函数，X、U、E 是任意类型；forget_inputs_determined_iff 是双向的。 / No premise: F is any function and X, U, E any types; forget_inputs_determined_iff is two-way.
- 固定相对于确定性（P53）：inputs_intervention_unfixed 另要运行未取 (u′, e′) 于 x 与 X 中两个不同的元素，写在定理中。 / Fixing is relative to determinacy (P53): inputs_intervention_unfixed further needs (u′, e′) untaken at x and two different elements of X, written into the theorem.
- 干预作用于整个动作 (u′, e′)；只定输入而噪声未表示的动作，是忘掉噪声的过程中的动作，它何时有唯一结果由 forget_inputs_determined_iff 的全局形式界定。 / An intervention acts on the whole move (u′, e′); a move fixing the input with the noise unrepresented is a move of the process with the noise forgotten, and when it has a unique outcome is bounded by the global form of forget_inputs_determined_iff.
- 离散的步；没有概率；x′ = F(x, u, ε) 的形式取自 Ren 贴入的文字（作者未注明，不是 Ren 的话，也不是前提）。 / Discrete steps; no probabilities; the form x′ = F(x, u, ε) is taken from the text Ren pasted (author not stated, not Ren's wording, not a premise).

Ren 2026-10-12 问 cause–effect system 与本理论相比如何，贴入作者未注明的说明（其中“changing an input through an intervention can change the resulting state”不是 Ren 的话），对 AI 的五项提议答：“Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”。这是第五项，工作板 P68。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：干预是未取的动作，由模型而不由记录固定；retarget 是在一个配置与一个动作上替换一条结构方程；噪声是未表示的动作；Joint 中冲击作为动作（Shock）与写进步骤（Hidden）的对照，是忘掉噪声的见证；Coarse 可读作噪声被忘掉的过程。见整合文档 §88。 / On 12 October 2026 Ren asked how a cause–effect system compares with the theory, pasted an explanation whose author is not stated (its “changing an input through an intervention can change the resulting state” is not Ren's wording), and to the AI's five proposals answered “Great, let's finish all of them, you can spawn sub agents in a wise order if needed”. This is the fifth proposal, work-board item P68. Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): an intervention is a move not taken, fixed by a model and not by the record; retarget replaces one structural equation at one configuration and move; noise is a move not represented; Joint's contrast between a shock as a move (Shock) and written into the step (Hidden) witnesses forgetting the noise; Coarse reads as a process with its noise forgotten. See §88 of the integration note.

- 噪声写进一步的关系而不写进动作时，动作不决定一步，单独汲取者的损失成为多重决定（Hidden.shock_in_the_step）；forget_inputs_determined_iff 对每个 F 刻画这何时发生。 / With the noise written into the step relation rather than the move, the move does not determine the step and the lone drawer's loss is overdetermined (Hidden.shock_in_the_step); forget_inputs_determined_iff characterizes for every F when this happens.
